versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the text-to-published-podcast-rss skill.
- Instantly convert text into podcast episodes using TTS and auto-publish to an RSS feed.
- Simple setup: connect an API key from cast0.ai and manage podcast settings via the dashboard.
- Supports episode creation, status polling, and listing through easy API endpoints.
- Generated RSS feed is compatible with all major podcast players, enabling immediate subscription and listening.
